head: 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e
notes: go test -count=1 ./internal/server/ green and go vet ./internal/server/ clean at the pinned head (ACTION-REVIEW-TEST-003/004). Known-ledger rows for internal/server were read and not re-reported. Cross-chunk: spec-8 reserved-name rejection (default/archived) and spec-14 cross-instance registry behavior live in internal/repos (other chunk) and were not verified here.

findings.claim: bootstrapEnv rejects double quote, single quote and newline (ContainsAny "\"'\n"), but TestBootstrapEnv only covers the double-quote and newline cases; dropping the single quote from the reject set keeps the suite green while an extra prompt like `don't skip` reaches the wrapper's BOOTSTRAP_EXTRA_PROMPT unguarded.
findings.evidence: Re-read bootstrap.go:181-188 (reject set includes the single quote) and bootstrap_test.go:71-89 (only `say "hi"` and "line one\nline two" fail cases). Spec-9 Tests row TestBootstrapEnv names 'extra prompt with quote/newline → error'; no case feeds a single quote. Claim holds.
findings.fix: Add a quote-single-in-extra-prompt case (extraPrompt "don't", _shouldPass false, _expected nil) to TestBootstrapEnv.

findings.claim: The casual+de template-seeding branch of saveProfileSelection (read settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.de.md, strip its frontmatter, use it as body) never executes in tests: the de-casual-creates case runs from the package dir where the relative template path is absent, so a wrong path or a broken stripFrontMatter call ships green and a fresh casual German profile is written without the template body.
findings.evidence: Re-read presentation.go:97-103 (relative templatePath, read error silently ignored) and presentation_test.go:318-331 (comment states the template is not readable from the test cwd; expected content is frontmatter-only). Spec-12 Tests row TestPresentationStore_SaveProfileSelection names 'de+non-developer seeds the template body'; only the fallback is exercised. The spec comment accepts the fallback, but config_sync_test.go:123 shows t.Chdir is already the package's way to stage a cwd-relative file. Claim holds.
findings.fix: Add a case that t.Chdir()s into a temp dir holding settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.de.md with frontmatter+body and asserts the written file carries the new frontmatter plus that body.

findings.claim: The archive tab's delete form is never asserted: the archive-unarchive-delete-flow subtest checks the rendered tab only for the folder name and 'Unarchive', then POSTs the delete route directly, so a wrong hx-post path or a dropped delete form in sessions_archive.html ships green.
findings.evidence: Re-read sessions_test.go:213-237 (GET /sessions/archive asserts "oldscope" and "Unarchive"; delete is exercised via formPost to /sessions/archive/oldscope/delete) and sessions_archive.html:19-27 (unarchive and delete forms). Spec-8 Tests row internal/server/sessions_test.go names 'archive tab renders ArchivedFolders with unarchive/delete forms'. Claim holds.
findings.fix: In the archive-tab GET assertion add assert.Contains(body, `hx-post="/sessions/archive/oldscope/delete"`) next to the Unarchive check.

findings.claim: Spec-8's repos_test case 'add with reserved name default/archived → rejected' is covered only for `default`; no handler-level test posts name=archived, so the server-side pre-git-init rejection of the name that collides with the sessions archived/ folder is unpinned in this chunk.
findings.evidence: Re-read repos_test.go:664-676 (reserved-name subtest posts only name=default) and repos.go:573-578 (Validate runs before the git-init op). Spec-8 Tests row 'internal/server/overview_test.go / repos_test.go' names both reserved names. The registry-level TestRepoValidate lives in internal/repos (other chunk) and was not verified. Claim holds for this chunk.
findings.fix: Turn reserved-name-is-bad-request-before-git-init into a two-case loop over {"default", "archived"}.

findings.claim: profilePageData's binding of the stored profile into the form (audience selected, language selected, dev_mode checked, dev_mode disabled under casual) is untested: TestServer_HandleProfilePage renders only with no profile file and asserts 'Profile' and 'style_content'. If DevMode were mis-bound, a dev-mode install would render the checkbox unchecked and the next unrelated save (e.g. a language change) would silently turn dev mode off — with the suite green.
findings.evidence: Re-read profilesettings.go:158-174 (Audience/DevMode/Language copied from the store), profile.html:9-24 (selected/checked/disabled driven by those fields; a plain form POST omits an unchecked dev_mode) and profilesettings_test.go:24-37 (empty profile path, two Contains assertions). No other test GETs /profile. Claim holds.
findings.fix: Add a TestServer_HandleProfilePage case seeded with `language: en / audience: / dev-mode: true` asserting `name="dev_mode" checked`, and one with the casual de profile asserting `value="casual" selected`, `value="de" selected` and the dev_mode input disabled.

findings.claim: The setup tab's new bootstrap form defaults (since = today-30d, max = today) are never asserted: TestWelcomeRendersAllChecks GETs /welcome but checks only the setup-check rows, so a wrong offset or format in handleWelcome pre-fills the since field with a date that bootstrapEnv then forwards as BOOTSTRAP_SINCE, with the suite green.
findings.evidence: Re-read welcome.go:288-294 (BootstrapSinceDefault/BootstrapToday computed only on the setup tab), welcome.html:23-25 (they feed the date input value and max) and welcome_test.go:15-38 (no assertion on name="since" or its value). No other test renders the setup tab's bootstrap form. Distinct from known code-style-NIT-18-r2, which is about the hard-coded -30 literal, not coverage. Claim holds.
findings.fix: In TestWelcomeRendersAllChecks assert the body contains `name="since" value="` + time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -30).Format(time.DateOnly) and `max="` + time.Now().Format(time.DateOnly).
